kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public dsg-query-details --page-size 10 --end-time 2026-06-30_23:59:59 --ip 203.107.80.20 --begin-time 2026-06-26_00:00:00 --page-no 10 --sens-level 3 --project-id dsg_demo_gw --rule-type '姓名' --engine-name ODPS.ODPS --node-id 123541234 --user dsg_test --ip-aare '中国-北京市-北京市' --rows 1 --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DsgQueryDetails

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 1000
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的数据量，最大值为1000
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query range. Example: "2026-06-30 23:59:59"
parameters.help_zh:
查询范围的截止时间，参考值为“2026-06-30 23:59:59”

格式示例为 `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`，例如 `2026-06-30 23:59:59`
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The internal IP address of the ECU
parameters.name: ip

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query range. Example: "2026-06-26 00:00:00"
parameters.help_zh:
查询范围的开始时间，参考值为“2026-06-26 00:00:00”

格式示例为 `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`，例如 `2026-06-26 00:00:00`
parameters.name: begin_time

parameters.help_en: The project workspace name (essentially ProjectName). Example: dsg_demo_gw
parameters.help_zh: 项目空间名称（本质上ProjectName），参考值：dsg_demo_gw
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The type of triggered sensitive rule. Example: Name
parameters.help_zh: 触发的敏感规则类型，参考值：姓名
parameters.name: rule_type

parameters.help_en:
The engine type. Valid values:
ODPS.ODPS
EMR
HOLO.POSTGRES
parameters.help_zh:
引擎类型。取值如下：
ODPS.ODPS
EMR
HOLO.POSTGRES
parameters.name: engine_name

parameters.help_en: The region to which the IP address belongs. Example: China-Beijing-Beijing, or internal IP address
parameters.help_zh: IP所属区域，参考值为：中国-北京市-北京市、内网IP
parameters.name: ip_aare

parameters.help_en: The minimum value of the export volume
parameters.name: rows
